statement: DescriptorChecksum returns the empty string if and only if at least one payload character is absent from INPUT_CHARSET.
notes: Prop over checksum model; returned-empty sentinel is exposed.

statement: Every group of three payload characters contributes one extra PolyMod symbol equal to 3*cls + (position >> 5), and a final partial group contributes its accumulated class value.
notes: Internal three-character grouping is private to descriptorChecksum; covered by checksum vectors.

statement: After all payload symbols, DescriptorChecksum applies eight zero-valued PolyMod steps and XORs the result with 1 before choosing checksum characters.
notes: Internal eight shift rounds and XOR are private to descriptorChecksum; covered by checksum vectors.

statement: The j-th checksum character is CHECKSUM_CHARSET[(c >> (5*(7-j))) & 31] for j from 0 through 7.
notes: Internal base32 emission is private; output length/alphabet exercised by vectors.

statement: AddChecksum(s) is exactly s concatenated with '#' and the eight-character DescriptorChecksum(s).
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: CheckChecksum rejects any descriptor containing two or more '#' characters.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: When require_checksum is true, a descriptor without '#' is rejected with the error text 'Missing checksum'.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: When a checksum is present, CheckChecksum rejects it unless it is exactly eight characters long.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A present checksum that differs from DescriptorChecksum(payload) is rejected and no descriptor is returned.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: Parse succeeds only when ParseScript consumes the entire input remaining after checksum removal.
notes: Whole-input consumption is internal to parsePayload; covered by parser vectors.

statement: A hexadecimal public key that is valid but hybrid (prefix 0x06 or 0x07) is rejected.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: An uncompressed public key is accepted only when the parse context is TOP or P2SH; every nested segwit or taproot context rejects it.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A 32-byte hexadecimal key is accepted only in P2TR context, where it is lifted to a compressed key with an even-y prefix.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: Parsing an xprv stores its private key in the signing provider and continues expansion from the neutered xpub.
notes: xprv/private-key path is not modelled (Parse accepts xpub/tpub only).

statement: A trailing '*' selects unhardened ranged derivation, while a trailing '*\'' or '*h' selects hardened ranged derivation.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A key origin fingerprint is accepted only as exactly eight hexadecimal characters, which decode to four bytes.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A key path element is hardened exactly when its last character is '\'' or 'h', and its numeric value must be strictly less than 2^31.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A multipath specifier contains at least two alternatives and rejects repeated numeric values.
notes: Multipath specifiers are not modelled; model rejects them as unsupported.

statement: ParsePubkey calls ParseKeyPath with allow_multipath=false for the key origin, so a multipath specifier inside brackets is rejected.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: pk(K) expands to a single script consisting of the key push followed by OP_CHECKSIG, using a 32-byte push when the context is P2TR.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: pkh(K) expands to OP_DUP OP_HASH160 <HASH160(K)> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_CHECKSIG.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: wpkh(K) expands to a witness-v0 key-hash program: OP_0 followed by the 20-byte HASH160(K) push.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: sh(X) expands to OP_HASH160 <HASH160(script(X))> OP_EQUAL and records script(X) as the redeem script.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: wsh(X) expands to a witness-v0 script-hash program: OP_0 followed by the 32-byte SHA256(script(X)) push, and records script(X) as the witness script.
notes: wsh is outside the committed Expand fragment.

statement: multi preserves descriptor key order, while sortedmulti sorts the expanded public keys lexicographically before constructing the CHECKMULTISIG script.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: In TOP context, multi and sortedmulti reject any key count greater than three.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: In P2SH context, multi rejects a script when script_size + 3 exceeds MAX_SCRIPT_ELEMENT_SIZE (520 bytes).
notes: sh(multi(...)) and redeem-script size accounting are outside the committed fragment.

statement: tr(internal) with no script leaves finalizes a TaprootBuilder with an empty branch and outputs the witness-v1 program of the BIP341-tweaked internal key.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed descriptor model.

statement: A tr() script tree whose nesting depth exceeds TAPROOT_CONTROL_MAX_NODE_COUNT is rejected during parsing.
notes: Taproot script trees and depth checks are outside the committed fragment.

statement: combo(K) expands to P2PK and P2PKH, and additionally to P2WPKH and P2SH-P2WPKH when K is compressed.
notes: combo() is outside the committed fragment.

statement: Each miniscript type character maps to a distinct bit in the type bitmap, covering B,V,K,W,z,o,n,d,u,e,f,s,m,x,g,h,i,j,k.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ComputeType(PK_K) is exactly Konudemsxk in every context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ComputeType(PK_H) is exactly Knudemsxk in every context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: OLDER(n) carries g when n has the sequence lock-time flag and h otherwise, in addition to Bzfmxk.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: AFTER(n) carries i when n is at least LOCKTIME_THRESHOLD and j otherwise, in addition to Bzfmxk.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: Each of SHA256, HASH256, RIPEMD160 and HASH160 computes type Bonudmk.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_A has W exactly when its child has B, inherits the child's timelock and satisfaction properties, and always adds x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_S has W exactly when its child has both B and o, and otherwise inherits the child's properties including x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_C has B exactly when its child has K, always has u and s, and inherits o,n,d,f,e,m plus timelock properties from the child.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_D has B exactly when its child has both V and z, has u only in Tapscript context, and always has n,d,x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_V has V exactly when its child has B, always has f and x, and inherits the child's satisfaction and timelock properties.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: WRAP_J has B exactly when its child has both B and n, and always has n,d,x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: AND_V takes B, V or K from its right child when its left child has V, and has k only when neither child mixes height and time locks.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: AND_B has B exactly when its left child has B and its right child has W, always has u and x, and composes e only when both children have e and s.
notes: Corrected statement; rules-wallet.yaml is authoritative. Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: OR_B has B exactly when the left child has B and d and the right child has W and d, and always has d,u,x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: OR_D has B exactly when its left child has B,d,u and its right child has B, takes u,f,d,e from its right child, and always has x.
notes: Corrected statement; rules-wallet.yaml is authoritative. Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: OR_C has V exactly when its left child has B,d,u and its right child has V, and always has f and x.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: OR_I intersects B, V and K across both children, has o exactly when both children have z, and takes d from either child.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ANDOR takes B, K or V from its second and third children when its first child has B,d,u, and takes d only from its third child.
notes: andor is not a constructor of the committed node model (Bitcoin/Wallet/Miniscript/Node.lean, Modelled fragments); Core anchor script/miniscript.cpp:206 (Fragment::ANDOR ComputeType). No API for the B/K/V transfer or d-only-from-third rule; not replaced by an invented node.

statement: MULTI has type Bnudemsk and is valid only in P2WSH context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: MULTI_A has type Budemsk and is valid only in Tapscript context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: THRESH requires its first child to have B,d,u and every later child to have W,d,u, and has k only when every child has k and either k <= 1, or 2 <= k and no height/time lock mix occurs among its branches.
notes: Corrected statement; rules-wallet.yaml is authoritative. Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model. WRONG row: not an open obligation.

statement: ToScript emits PK_K as the key push alone and PK_H as OP_DUP OP_HASH160 <keyhash> OP_EQUALVERIFY.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ToScript emits OLDER as <n> OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY, AFTER as <n> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY, and each hash fragment as OP_SIZE 32 OP_EQUALVERIFY <hash-op> <digest> followed by OP_EQUAL or OP_EQUALVERIFY according to verify context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ToScript emits a:,s:,c:,d:,v:,j:,n: wrappers as altstack round-trip, swap, checksig/checksigverify, dup-if, verify-or-last-opcode, size-nonzero-if, and 0notequal respectively.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ToScript emits and_v by concatenation, and_b with OP_BOOLAND, or_b with OP_BOOLOR, or_d with OP_IFDUP OP_NOTIF, or_c with OP_NOTIF, or_i with OP_IF/OP_ELSE, and andor with OP_NOTIF/OP_ELSE.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ToScript emits MULTI as <k> followed by the key pushes and <n> OP_CHECKMULTISIG[VERIFY], and MULTI_A as <key0> OP_CHECKSIG followed by OP_CHECKSIGADD per later key and <k> OP_NUMEQUAL[VERIFY].
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: ToScript emits THRESH by concatenating the first child, then each later child followed by OP_ADD, then <k> OP_EQUAL or OP_EQUALVERIFY.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: A node is IsValid exactly when its computed type is non-empty and its ScriptSize is at most MaxScriptSize for its context.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: IsSane holds exactly when IsValidTopLevel, IsSaneSubexpression and NeedsSignature all hold.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: CheckOpsLimit accepts a P2WSH node exactly when its maximum ops is at most 201, and always accepts a Tapscript node.
notes: CheckOpsLimit, GetStaticOps and the Ops summary are absent from Bitcoin/Wallet/Miniscript/Satisfy.lean (module note: operation-count limit not modelled); Core anchor script/miniscript.h:1573. No API for the 201-op P2WSH bound or Tapscript unconditional acceptance.

statement: CheckStackSize bounds Tapscript execution stack by MAX_STACK_SIZE (1000) and P2WSH satisfaction stack by MAX_STANDARD_P2WSH_STACK_ITEMS (100).
notes: CheckStackSize, GetStackSize and GetExecStackSize are absent from Bitcoin/Wallet/Miniscript/Satisfy.lean (module note: execution stack-size limit not modelled); Core anchor script/miniscript.h:1595. No API for MAX_STACK_SIZE 1000 or MAX_STANDARD_P2WSH_STACK_ITEMS 100.

statement: When nonmalleable is true, Satisfy returns NO if the produced satisfaction is malleable or contains no signature.
notes: The satisfaction model records only none/some (InputResult = Option stack × Option stack) and has no malleable or has_sig flag (Bitcoin/Wallet/Miniscript/Satisfy.lean module note); Core anchor script/miniscript.h:1709 (Satisfy nonmalleable check). No API for nonmalleable=true.

statement: ProduceInput emits exactly one signature stack element for a PK_K node when the satisfier can sign, and returns unavailable otherwise.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed Miniscript model.

statement: FromString accepts multi_a only in TAPSCRIPT context and multi only in P2WSH context, and rejects key counts above the context's MAX_PUBKEYS bound.
notes: No Miniscript FromString parser is committed (Bitcoin/Wallet/Miniscript.lean scope note: no FromString); Core anchor script/miniscript.h:1901. No API for context-sensitive multi/multi_a acceptance or the MAX_PUBKEYS bound.

statement: A PSBT stream is accepted only if it begins with the five bytes 0x70 0x73 0x62 0x74 0xff.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: Every map record is a length-prefixed key followed by a length-prefixed value, and a stated length that disagrees with the decoded fields is rejected.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: Two records with identical key bytes in the same map are rejected as a duplicate key.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A v0 global unsigned transaction is rejected if any input scriptSig is non-empty or any input scriptWitness is non-null.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A PSBT with version 0 is rejected unless PSBT_GLOBAL_UNSIGNED_TX is present.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A PSBT with version 0 is rejected if any of TX_VERSION, FALLBACK_LOCKTIME, INPUT_COUNT, OUTPUT_COUNT or TX_MODIFIABLE is present.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A PSBT declaring version 1 is rejected because no PSBT version 1 exists.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A PSBT with version 2 requires TX_VERSION, INPUT_COUNT and OUTPUT_COUNT, and rejects PSBT_GLOBAL_UNSIGNED_TX.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB key is accepted only at its fixed extended-key-plus-version length and only when the embedded public key is fully valid.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A non-witness UTXO is serialized under type 0x00 as a full transaction without witness data.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A witness UTXO is serialized under type 0x01 as a single CTxOut.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: When either final_script_sig is non-empty or final_script_witness is non-null, partial signatures, sighash type, redeem script, witness script, key paths, preimages and taproot fields are not serialized.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: Final scriptSig and final scriptWitness are serialized under types 0x07 and 0x08 respectively.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A Taproot key-path signature is serialized under type 0x13 as a 64-byte or 65-byte value.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A Taproot script-path signature uses a 64-byte key consisting of the x-only pubkey followed by the leaf hash, under type 0x14.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A Taproot leaf script is serialized under type 0x15 with the control block as key and the script followed by its leaf version as value.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A Taproot BIP32 derivation record uses a 32-byte x-only key and a value consisting of a leaf-hash set followed by a key origin.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: A Taproot output tree record is rejected if empty, if a leaf depth exceeds TAPROOT_CONTROL_MAX_NODE_COUNT, if a leaf version has bits outside TAPROOT_LEAF_MASK, or if the resulting builder is incomplete.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: PSBTInput::GetUTXO prefers non_witness_utxo and requires its txid and output index to match prev_txid and prev_out; otherwise it returns witness_utxo; otherwise it returns false.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: When only witness_utxo is available, SignPSBTInput fails with INCOMPLETE unless the produced signature data is a witness signature.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: If neither the caller nor the input specifies a sighash type, SignPSBTInput uses SIGHASH_DEFAULT for Taproot prevouts and SIGHASH_ALL otherwise, and rejects an explicit input type that differs.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: When a non-default sighash is selected, every existing Taproot key signature must be 65 bytes with that type as its last byte, every Taproot script signature must likewise be 65 bytes with that type, and every ECDSA partial signature must end in that type.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: Two PSBTs merge only when both expose the same unique transaction id and declare the same version.
notes: PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge has no committed analogue in Bitcoin.Wallet.Psbt.*; Core anchor psbt.cpp:42. No merge function over which to state the unique-txid/version precondition.

statement: Input merge keeps an existing non-empty field, fills only empty fields from the other input, and unions maps whose keys are distinct.
notes: PSBTInput::Merge has no committed analogue in Bitcoin.Wallet.Psbt.*; Core anchor psbt.cpp:420. No input-merge function for existing-field precedence or distinct-key map union.

statement: AddInput rejects an input whose prevout duplicates an input already present in the PSBT.
notes: PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput has no committed analogue in Bitcoin.Wallet.Psbt.*; Core anchor psbt.cpp:169. Decode.checkUtxos checks non-witness-UTXO hash/index only, not duplicate prevouts, so no API for this rejection.

statement: For PSBT version 2, ComputeTimeLock returns the maximum height lock if any positive height lock exists, otherwise the maximum time lock, and returns nullopt when different inputs require one height lock and one time lock.
notes: PSBT v2 is excluded (Bitcoin/Wallet/Psbt/Model.lean: version 2 deliberately not modelled); there is no Input.time_locktime/height_locktime or ComputeTimeLock. Core anchor psbt.cpp:92. The v2 height/time aggregation is not expressible.

statement: GetUnsignedTx sets every missing input sequence to SEQUENCE_FINAL and fails if ComputeTimeLock fails.
notes: PSBT v2 is excluded (Bitcoin/Wallet/Psbt/Model.lean: version 2 deliberately not modelled); there is no GetUnsignedTx or v2 sequence field. Core anchor psbt.cpp:134. SEQUENCE_FINAL filling and ComputeTimeLock failure are not expressible.

statement: FinalizePSBT invokes SignPSBTInput with no keys and finalize=true on every input, and returns true only if every input finalises successfully.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: FinalizeAndExtractPSBT returns false if FinalizePSBT fails, and otherwise copies each input's final scriptSig and final scriptWitness into the reconstructed unsigned transaction.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed PSBT model.

statement: PSBTInputSignedAndVerified validates the non-witness UTXO against the prevout and then executes VerifyScript with STANDARD_SCRIPT_VERIFY_FLAGS on the reconstructed unsigned transaction.
notes: Signing/lifecycle behaviour; not expressible over the committed PSBT model without the signer bridge.

statement: AvailableCoins omits any wallet output for which IsSpent(outpoint) holds.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: AvailableCoins excludes outputs from unsafe transactions unless include_unsafe_inputs is set, and otherwise includes only transactions it deems trusted or safe.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: For a coin with known input size, effective_value equals txout.nValue minus the fee for input_bytes at the effective feerate.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The positive-only coin group includes exactly those outputs whose effective value is strictly greater than zero.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: BnB treats a selection as a potential solution exactly when its amount lies between selection_target and selection_target + cost_of_change inclusive, and shifts away from selections above that upper bound.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: BnB stops after TOTAL_TRIES (100000) node expansions and marks the result as not guaranteed optimal.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: BnB shifts away from any partial selection whose accumulated weight exceeds max_selection_weight.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: SRD raises its target by CHANGE_LOWER plus change_fee before selecting, so a barely-covered target does not produce tiny change.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: When an SRD selection exceeds max_selection_weight, it repeatedly removes the least valuable selected group until the weight fits or the selection is empty.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: Knapsack immediately returns a single group whose selection amount equals the target, provided its weight fits.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: When the sum of lower groups is below the target, Knapsack spends the smallest single group above the target, or fails if none exists.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: ApproximateBestSubset performs at most 1000 randomised passes and retains the smallest reachable total at or above the target that fits the weight limit.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: GenerateChangeTarget returns change_fee + CHANGE_LOWER when the mean payment is at most CHANGE_LOWER/2, and otherwise change_fee plus a uniform value in [CHANGE_LOWER, min(2*payment, CHANGE_UPPER)).
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: SelectionResult::GetChange returns zero whenever the computed change is below min_viable_change, and otherwise returns the computed change.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed spend arithmetic model.

statement: Selection waste equals the sum over inputs of (fee - long_term_fee), minus any bump-fee discount, plus change_cost when change is created, or plus the excess over target when no change is created.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: ChooseSelectionResult runs BnB unless SFFO is active, always runs Knapsack and SRD, and additionally runs CoinGrinder only when the effective feerate exceeds three times the long-term feerate.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The maximum selection weight is the transaction weight limit minus the weight of the header and recipient outputs, then minus the change-output weight for algorithms that may create change.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: When subtract-fee-from-outputs is active, ChooseSelectionResult does not run BnB and starts with the algorithms that may create change.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: CreateTransaction rejects a recipient whose output is dust under the wallet's relay dust fee before coin selection begins.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The selection target equals the sum of recipient amounts plus the effective-feerate fee for the non-input, non-change transaction size, except that SFFO excludes that fee.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The minimum viable change equals the maximum of (change_spend_fee + 1) and the dust threshold of the change output at the discard feerate.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed spend arithmetic model.

statement: The cost of change equals the discard-feerate fee for spending the change output plus the effective-feerate fee for creating it.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The required fee equals the effective-feerate fee for the estimated signed virtual size plus the selected inputs' total ancestor bump fees.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: If a change output exists and the current fee exceeds the required fee, CreateTransaction increases the change value by the difference and re-checks that fee needed equals fee paid.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: Under SFFO, the fee shortfall is divided equally among flagged recipients, with the remainder charged to the first flagged recipient, and any resulting dust or negative output aborts the transaction.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed spend arithmetic model.

statement: CreateTransaction aborts if the required fee exceeds the fee actually paid after all adjustments.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: CreateTransaction rejects a signed transaction whose actual weight exceeds MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT, and an unsigned one whose estimated weight does.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: CreateTransaction rejects a transaction whose fee exceeds the wallet's absolute maximum fee or whose fee exceeds the maximum fee rate applied to its virtual size.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: After change construction, CreateTransaction assumes recipients_sum + change_amount equals the sum of output values, and rejects a negative fee computed as selected value minus output value.
notes: Declared Prop over the committed spend arithmetic model.

statement: GetMinimumFeeRate uses an explicit coin-control feerate first, then the confirmation-target estimator, then the wallet fallback fee, and raises the result to at least the required feerate.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: GetDiscardRate never returns a rate below the chain's relay dust fee.
notes: Policy/selection algorithm, randomness, or wallet state not modelled by the committed spend arithmetic.

statement: The single-argument CWallet::SignTransaction overload builds the wallet coin map and delegates to the sighash-taking overload with SIGHASH_DEFAULT.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: CWallet::SignTransaction returns true as soon as one ScriptPubKeyMan reports that the transaction is fully signed, and otherwise tries every manager.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan::SignTransaction builds a merged signing provider from every coin's scriptPubKey and then calls the generic SignTransaction with the requested sighash.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: GetSigningProvider expands the descriptor at the script's derivation index from the descriptor cache and reuses a cached provider when one exists.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: When the descriptor manager has private keys and include_private is true, GetSigningProvider calls ExpandPrivate for the same index and includes the resulting keys.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: CreateSig replaces SIGHASH_DEFAULT with SIGHASH_ALL for BASE and WITNESS_V0 signatures and refuses SIGHASH_SINGLE when the input index has no corresponding output.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: CreateSig refuses an uncompressed key for WITNESS_V0 and refuses a WITNESS_V0 signature when the spent amount is outside MoneyRange.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: CreateSchnorrSig requires precomputed BIP341 data and spent outputs, signs without an annex or OP_CODESEPARATOR, and requires a leaf hash for TAPSCRIPT.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: SignTaproot first attempts a key-path signature with the internal key and its merkle root, and only if that fails attempts the output key with a null merkle root.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: SignTaprootScript signs a script leaf only when its leaf version equals TAPROOT_LEAF_TAPSCRIPT, and parses the leaf as miniscript.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: The Taproot tweak for an internal key is taggedHash("TapTweak", internal_xonly) when the merkle root is null and taggedHash("TapTweak", internal_xonly || merkle_root) otherwise, where taggedHash("TapTweak", msg) = SHA256(SHA256("TapTweak") || SHA256("TapTweak") || msg); these are the taptweak_none and taptweak_some equations.
notes: Corrected statement; rules-wallet.yaml is authoritative. Differential: no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: KeyPair construction with a non-null merkle root adds the TapTweak hash to the secret key before producing a Schnorr signature.
notes: Signing-path behaviour; no wallet signing model is committed (SignerSpec boundary).

statement: CreateSchnorrSig looks up the private key by x-only public key and fails if no matching key exists.
